description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different document processing methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10 with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. There are four lines shown: a black solid line with circle markers representing "DPR w/o query", which begins at approximately 35.2 and ends at approximately 35.7; a red solid line with circle markers representing "DPR w/ corpus expansion", which begins at approximately 35.4 and ends at approximately 35.9; a green solid line with triangle markers representing "DPR w/ document expansion", which begins at approximately 34.8 and ends at approximately 34.9; and a blue solid line with star markers representing "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion", which begins at approximately 34.6 and ends at approximately 34.4.
